name: Being Distracted
overview: Scripture teaches that being distracted often stems from misplaced priorities, as Jesus reminds us that where our treasure is, there our heart will be also (Matthew 6:21; Luke 12:34). The example of Martha receiving Jesus into her home (Luke 10:38) contrasts with the call to focus on seeking God actively and persistently (Matthew 7:7). James further exhorts believers to lay aside distractions and sin, embracing and living out the Word with humility and obedience (James 1:21-22), highlighting that true spiritual focus requires both hearing and doing God's Word.
